title: License vehicles that carry dangerous goods in bulk
what: As a prime contractor, transport dangerous goods only in a vehicle licensed as the regulations require; consignors must not consign goods for an unlicensed vehicle (s 28(2)).

sources.title: Dangerous Goods (Road Transport) Act 2009 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 28(1) (current republication (R11, from 16 December 2025; Dangerous Goods (Road Transport) Act 2009 | Acts))
sources.quote: A prime contractor must not use a vehicle to transport dangerous goods (other than as the driver of the vehicle) if— (a) a regulation requires the vehicle to be licensed to transport the goods; and (b) the vehicle is not licensed as required

administration.who: Competent authority declared under the Dangerous Goods (Road Transport) Act 2009 (ACT), s 20

reach.condition: if it transports or consigns dangerous goods by road in vehicles the regulations require to be licensed
